subject: Proposal: Dedicated VPC expansion + term amendment for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-05 09:02 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: renewal + VPC expansion planning

Hi Sarah —

As we approach your contract renewal (Dec 1), we wanted to start alignment on the Private/VPC expansion you outlined in the QBR: a second isolated environment for analytics (same region), two additional inference clusters for peak throughput, and stricter ACL-based tenancy isolation.

Attached is a first-pass provisioning matrix (nimbus_provisioning_matrix_v2.xlsx) that maps node counts, estimated RPS, and expected latency. Quick asks to unblock planning:
- Confirm target go-live window (you mentioned early Q1)
- Which environments need KMS/HSM integration vs. standard KMS?
- Any region-specific compliance (e.g., additional logging retention) beyond SOC2?

Operational options we can offer at renewal:
- 12mo term extension in exchange for reserved capacity discounts on the two new clusters
- Staged provisioning (analytics env first, inference cluster second) to smooth capacity ramp

Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week to review the matrix and commercial options? I can include Priyom (on capacity planning) and Monica (on onboarding/ops).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: nimbus_provisioning_matrix_v2.xlsx]
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-06 11:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: renewal + VPC expansion planning

Vanessa — thanks for the matrix. We are definitely interested in moving forward but a few clarifying items: 

1) Isolation/tenancy: For analytics we need tenant-level encryption keys separated from prod. That will require HSM-backed KMS for the analytics environment.
2) SLA: Can you confirm latency SLOs for the new inference clusters under 99th percentile? Our procurement also wants a clear fall-back plan if capacity spikes.
3) Commercial: Procurement wants a headcount of engineers required for the split environment — who will own runbooks?

We can do a sync Monday 10/11 at 10:00am PT. I'll loop in Procurement so they can review the draft amendment.

—Sarah
Sarah Kim
Director of Platform Engineering | Nimbus Health
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12 10:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: renewal + VPC expansion planning

Vanessa — following our internal capacity review, here are commercial options we should propose to Nimbus: 

Option A (Conservative):
- 12-month extension to current term
- Add 2 dedicated inference clusters (T4-equivalent capacity per cluster) + 1 HSM-backed analytics environment
- 18% discount on the incremental reserved capacity if signed at renewal
- Included: 6 hours/month of RedTeam runbook support for first 3 months (handover to Nimbus ops thereafter)

Option B (Aggressive, phased):
- 24-month extension with reduced per-month pricing on clusters
- Phased provision: analytics env first (target 30-45 days), clusters on 60–90 day cadence
- Priority provisioning window and burst capacity SLA add-on

I pulled together a draft term amendment with redlines and a short statement of work for runbook delivery. Attached: term_amendment_draft.pdf. Recommend we present Option A in the first customer call and flag B as a fast-track alternative if they commit to 24 months.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: term_amendment_draft.pdf]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-14 08:42 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Dedicated VPC expansion + term amendment for Nimbus Health

Sarah / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick reply and for joining the sync. Per the call, attached are two concrete options (Ben's commercial framing) and the provisioning matrix reflecting HSM needs. Summary of our recommended path:

- Near-term: Execute Option A (12mo extension + 2 clusters + HSM analytics environment) to lock pricing and reserve capacity for Q1 provisioning.
- Deliverables before go-live: runbooks (Redwood + Nimbus owners), KMS/HSM integration checklist, test plan for failover and capacity spikes.
- Timeline: sign amendment by Dec 1, analytics env provisioned by Jan 20, inference clusters ready by Mar 1 (phased).

Next steps:
1) Procurement: please review the attached term_amendment_draft.pdf and provide two comments by EOD Oct 20.
2) Sarah/P&E: confirm KMS vendor and whether we need on-prem key injection (HSM) or cloud HSM.
3) Ops kick: schedule 60-min runbook session with Priyom and Monica the week of Jan 8.

I've also attached a short SOC2 summary we use for procurement checklists (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). Let me know if you'd like the full package.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: term_amendment_draft.pdf, nimbus_provisioning_matrix_v2.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf]
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-21 16:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Dedicated VPC expansion + term amendment for Nimbus Health

Vanessa — appreciate the clear options. Procurement reviewed the draft and asked for two small changes (payment milestone for provisioning and a simplified indemnity clause) — I'll send tracked edits by tomorrow. We are aligned with Option A provided the HSM approach is cloud HSM (simpler for us) and Redwood will commit to the priority provisioning SLA window for the analytics env.

We can confirm sign-off on Dec 1 once the edits are accepted. Scheduling note: Jan 8 for the runbook session works for our team.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Director of Platform Engineering | Nimbus Health
